# Freim Deploy

> Renamed: the product used to be called FrostDeploy. Same product, same
> repository (github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy), same installer. The on-disk names were
> deliberately NOT renamed and never will be: the install paths `/opt/frostdeploy` and
> `/srv/frostdeploy`, the CLI command `frostdeploy`, the systemd unit `frostdeploy.service`,
> the panel subdomain `frostdeploy.<domain>` and — most importantly — the per-repository
> config file `frostdeploy.json` all keep their old names so existing installs keep working.
> Never write `freimdeploy.json`; the file is and stays `frostdeploy.json`.

> Self-hosted deploy platform for your own VPS/VDS — a Vercel, Netlify, Render and Heroku
> alternative you fully own. Connect a Git repository, press Deploy: build, automatic HTTPS,
> custom domains and one-click rollback. Runs on Debian 12+ / Ubuntu 22.04+ without Docker.

Install (as root, on a fresh server):

```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/main/install.sh | sudo bash
```

Before installing, two DNS A records must point at the server IP: the apex (`@`) and a wildcard
(`*`). The panel listens on 127.0.0.1:9000 and is reached over an SSH tunnel for the first login,
then over HTTPS on the user's own domain.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): step-by-step install runbook written for AI agents — prerequisites, DNS, install, SSH tunnel, setup wizard, failure handling, safety rules
- [README.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/README.md): overview, quick start, features, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [README.ru.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/README.ru.md): the same in Russian
- [README.zh-CN.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): the same in Simplified Chinese
- [README.es.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/README.es.md): the same in Spanish
- [docs/frostdeploy-json.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/docs/frostdeploy-json.md): the project configuration reference — kind, build, run, assets, rootDir, runtime/role, python workers, multiservice `services[]`, deploy pipeline, limits
- [docs/first-deploy.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/docs/first-deploy.md): from a fresh install to the first site live on HTTPS
- [docs/environment-variables.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/docs/environment-variables.md): build-time vs runtime variables, public prefixes, why secrets never reach the build
- [docs/domains.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/docs/domains.md): platform addresses, custom domains, wildcard DNS, certificates, www, redirects
- [docs/servers.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/docs/servers.md): adding more servers to one panel
- [docs/operations.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/docs/operations.md): updates, rollback, incident recovery, backups, secrets, uninstall
- [docs/cms-portal.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/docs/cms-portal.md): the optional client CMS portal and what a site must provide to work with it
- [install.sh](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/blob/main/install.sh): the installer itself
- [Releases](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy/releases): signed builds

## Notes

- Supported: Debian 12+, Ubuntu 22.04+, x86_64, 1 GB RAM minimum, root access.
- Not supported: RHEL-family distributions, Alpine, Arch, arm64.
- Deploys Next.js, Astro, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Remix, Python services and static sites; frameworks are
  autodetected.
- The application source code is private; this repository distributes the installer and signed
  release builds.
